measurements.name: f_ta
measurements.spice: .meas tran f_ta WHEN v(clk)=1.8000 RISE=5

measurements.name: f_tb
measurements.spice: .meas tran f_tb WHEN v(clk)=1.8000 RISE=25

measurements.name: fosc
measurements.spice: .meas tran fosc PARAM='20/(f_tb-f_ta)'

measurements.name: iq_run
